Title: International Analytics Manager
Description:
Overview:

As International Analytics Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our client’s global presence. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, analyze market dynamics, and interact with marketing and business stakeholders to drive growth and engagement across international markets. If you’re passionate about sports, have a knack for strategic thinking, and thrive in a dynamic environment, this role is tailor-made for you

**Primary Location:** Across Canada

**Work Model:** Fully Remote

**Employment Type:** Contractor

**Vacancy Status:** New

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Hands-on Analytics**
* + Query and analyze data using SQL
  + Identify a problem or question and develop an analysis plan that adequately answers the question
  + Summarize data insights in a business-friendly way that is easy for stakeholders and executives to understand
  + Summarize large data outputs into key takeaways
  + Assist with user acceptance testing of database changes and updates
  + Enable data teams in the root cause analysis of issues and bugs
* **Activation and Enablement**
* + Evaluate one-to-one marketing campaign data needs and own data enablement for seamless campaign execution, including defined test and control groups and success criteria
  + Evaluate one-to-one audience needs and identify segmentation opportunities to drive and deepen fan engagement
* **Performance Tracking and Optimization**
* + Monitor the effectiveness of go-to-market strategies using relevant KPIs and attribution frameworks
  + Periodically assess performance against fanbase growth goals
  + Provide regular reports to senior leadership on international market performance
  + Regularly attend and provide input during strategy discussions with stakeholders
  + Work closely with stakeholders at the VP level
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* + Work closely with marketing, international, legal, and other stakeholders to align strategies and execution
  + Foster a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and innovation
  + Collaborate with data engineering teams on business requirements
  + Interact with third parties regarding data needs and definitions
* **Market Growth and Strategy Support**
* + Collaborate with regional teams to create data analytics and segmentation plans that support growth strategies for specific markets
  + Define clear objectives, KPIs, and success metrics for each market
  + Develop audience segments and marketing initiatives tailored to local nuances

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Analytics, or a related field
* At least 3 years of experience using SQL, Python, or other relevant coding languages
* At least 5 years of stakeholder management experience
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to drive decision-making
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to develop structured analytical approaches to business questions
* Ability to translate complex data outputs into clear, business-friendly insights
* Experience collaborating with senior stakeholders, including those at the VP level
* Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, data engineering, legal, regional, and business teams

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience in fan, consumer, or marketing analytics
* Knowledge of consent management and/or identity resolution
* Passion for sports and an understanding of global fan cultures
* Experience with audience segmentation and one-to-one marketing campaigns
* Experience working with attribution frameworks, test and control groups, and campaign success criteria

Title: Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalization & Process Improvement
Description:
Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalisation & Process Improvement
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The Lead - Procurement Systems, Digitalisation & Process Improvement will be responsible for driving digital transformation initiatives across the procurement function through system enhancements, ERP optimisation, process automation, data analytics, and reporting improvements. The role will serve as the focal point between Procurement, IT, Digital Transformation, and business stakeholders to improve procurement efficiency, data visibility, system integration, and user adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Procurement Systems & ERP Enhancement

+ Lead continuous improvement initiatives for procurement-related systems and processes.
+ Manage procurement system integrations with ERP platforms such as SAP.
+ Identify opportunities to enhance system functionality, workflows, and user experience.
+ Coordinate with IT and business stakeholders to implement system upgrades and enhancements.
+ Support procurement digitisation projects and technology deployment initiatives.
+ Ensure data integrity, standardisation, and governance across procurement systems.

* Business Intelligence & Analytics

+ Develop and maintain procurement dashboards and performance reports using Power BI.
+ Utilise Power Query and advanced Excel tools for data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and analysis.
+ Analyse procurement performance metrics, spend data, supplier performance, and operational KPIs.
+ Generate meaningful insights and recommendations through data analytics and visualisation.
+ Design executive-level reports and presentations to support management decision-making.

* Automation & Process Improvement

+ Develop automated workflows using Power Automate.
+ Create business applications and workflow solutions using Power Apps.
+ Identify manual activities that can be automated to improve efficiency and reduce processing time.
+ Map existing procurement processes and develop future-state workflows using Visio.
+ Lead continuous improvement programmes focused on digitalisation and process optimisation.

* SharePoint & Collaboration Solutions

+ Develop and manage SharePoint-based procurement repositories, dashboards, and collaboration platforms.
+ Improve document management, workflow tracking, and information accessibility.
+ Support knowledge management and digital workplace initiatives within procurement.

* Reporting & Presentation Development

+ Develop professional procurement presentations and executive reports using PowerPoint.
+ Create infographics and visual communication materials for management reporting.
+ Translate complex data into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Act as the interface between procurement, supply chain, IT, digital transformation, and business units.
+ Gather business requirements and convert them into technical and system improvement initiatives.
+ Conduct user training and support change management activities during system implementations.
+ Provide technical guidance to procurement users on digital tools and reporting solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a Related Field.
* Professional certifications in SAP, Microsoft Power Platform, data analytics, or project management are advantageous.

**Experience Requirements**

* Typically 6-8+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain systems, business analytics, digital transformation, ERP implementation, or process improvement.
* Proven experience in procurement system implementation, enhancement, or integration projects.
* Experience working with procurement modules within ERP environments such as SAP.
* Demonstrated experience in business intelligence, reporting, process automation, and workflow optimisation.
* Experience interfacing with both business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent understanding of procurement processes and system-driven improvements.
* Highly proficient in data management, reporting, and dashboard development.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions.
* Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leading digitalisation, automation, or procurement transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable efficiency improvements through technology and process optimisation.

Title: Business Division Manager
Description:
***BUSINESS DIVISION MANAGER***
**Job Purpose**

* Lead and manage the business functions for the Beach Valves Project from concept development through project execution, ensuring effective project governance, planning and reporting, risk and change management, cost and schedule oversight, contracting and procurement support, and organisational readiness to enable safe, timely and effective delivery of the Project.
* The Business Division Manager is responsible for managing and integrating the business requirements of the Beach Valves Project throughout all project phases, from concept development through execution. The role requires close coordination across Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Finance, Legal, P&D and other supporting organisations.
* Establishing and maintaining fit-for-purpose project governance, controls, reporting, risk, change, planning and business processes appropriate to the maturity and execution phase of the project.
* Supporting Project Management in managing interfaces, priorities, emerging risks and decisions within a brownfield operating environment involving multiple stakeholders and existing facilities.
* Maintaining alignment between the company, contractors and key stakeholders to support timely decisions and achievement of safety, quality, cost and schedule objectives.

**REPORTING & RELATIONSHIPS**

* Reports to Project Manager

+ Direct Reports: 4.

* Internal Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with Project PMT.
+ Frequent contact within the Major Projects group and other departments such as Execution Planning and Services (EP&S), Legal, Supply, Operations, Finance, Other MP PMTs, and Shared Services.

* External Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with the EPC contractor, their sub-contractors, vendors and other third parties during the execution of the project.
+ Frequent contact with Beach Valves project shareholders.

**KEY JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Project Business Management: Lead and manage the project business functions and associated activities, including project governance, reporting, risk, change management, planning, cost, contracting and procurement support to enable achievement of project objectives.
* Governance & Business Framework: Establish and maintain the project business management framework from concept development through execution, ensuring appropriate processes, controls and governance arrangements are implemented in accordance with company requirements.
* Performance Management: Drive project performance through the review and coordination of schedule, cost, risk, change, KPIs, management reporting and other performance indicators, escalating areas requiring management intervention.
* Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Manage the preparation and coordination of project management reports, presentations, decision papers, committee submissions and approval documentation to meet governance requirements and enable timely, informed management decisions.
* Project Management System Compliance: Manage compliance with the company Project Management System (PMS) through coordination of applicable gate requirements, deliverables, reviews, findings and close-out actions to demonstrate project readiness for progression through the applicable lifecycle gates.
* Risk, Issue & Change Management: Lead project risk, issue and change management processes, ensuring risks and changes are identified, assessed, communicated, tracked and appropriately escalated to support informed project decisions.
* Organisational & Resource Planning: Coordinate project organisational and resource requirements, including recruitment, manpower planning, organisation charts, facilities and support services to maintain appropriate project capability through the different phases of execution.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate business interfaces with Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Legal, Finance, P&D and other Company organisations to facilitate timely decisions and resolution of Project issues.
* Contracting, Procurement & Commercial Support: Support project contracting, procurement and commercial activities through coordination of business requirements, change orders, management recommendations and interfaces with contractors, vendors and service providers to enable timely contractual and commercial decisions in support of project delivery.
* Compliance, Audits & Continuous Improvement: Monitor project business processes and procedural compliance, supporting internal and external reviews, audits, lessons learned and continuous improvement throughout project execution.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION - Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in: Business / Accounting / Commercial / Marketing / Sciences / Engineering / Project Management / Supply Chain Management / Law / Communication / Technologies / Mathematics / Statistics
* Knowledge & Experience

+ 12 years experience in a business-related function or discipline.
+ Including 8 years in the Oil & Gas Industry.
+ Including 3 years experience in a supervisory or acting role or oversight of contractor/subcontractor/service/vendor personnel.

* Technical & Business Skills

+ Strong knowledge in project business-related functions/disciplines such as planning, scheduling, cost control, estimating, claim management, risk management, change management, procurement, pre- and post-award contract management, actionable and informative reporting, support services, lessons learned, etc.
+ Extensive knowledge in international standards, best practices and methodologies as it relates to business disciplines.
+ Broad experience and demonstrated competence in managing a business function and disciplines, including contractors, cost and tenders.
+ Strong experience with risk assessment approach in decision-making.
+ Strong knowledge of relevant software and computer skills, e.g., dashboards, data analytics, SAP, etc.
+ Experience working in large-scale operating organisations in operations, projects, subsurface, etc.

Title: Senior Service Delivery Manager, IT
Description:
Founded in 1999,
**Audax Group**
is a leading alternative investment manager with offices in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London and Hong Kong. With approximately $42 billion of assets under management and more than 475 employees, Audax is a leading capital partner for middle market companies, operating through three business lines: Audax Private Equity, Audax Private Debt, and Audax Strategic Capital.
  
  
For more information, visit www.audaxgroup.com or follow Audax Group on LinkedIn.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Sr. Manager, Service Delivery is responsible for leading and continuously improving the firm's IT service delivery and end-user support function. This process-driven, customer-focused leader will oversee day-to-day support operations, establish consistent service-management practices, manage service levels and performance, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role serves as the operational owner of Freshservice and uses service data, automation, knowledge, self-service, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve operational performance and the employee experience. The Sr. Manager, Service Delivery will partner closely with Cloud & Endpoint, Security Operations, and Asset & Vendor Management on complex escalations and shared processes while remaining primarily focused on service leadership, process discipline, and service transformation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Service Delivery**

* Lead end-user support operations across Audax offices, providing a consistent, high-quality service experience for executives, investment professionals, and firmwide staff.
* Oversee ticket queues, workloads, escalations, staffing, schedules, coverage, and service risks to ensure work is appropriately prioritized and completed.
* Identify capacity, coverage, or service-delivery gaps and implement or recommend corrective action.

**IT Service Management / Freshservice**

* Own Freshservice as the firm's service-management platform and system of record, including platform adoption, data quality, reporting, workflows, and automation. Govern platform configuration and administration, directing a designated administrator within the IT Operations team for hands-on changes.
* Establish and continuously improve standards for ticket lifecycle management, incidents, requests, problems, approvals, escalations, and service levels.
* Govern the service catalog, self-service experience, knowledge management, and repeatable workflows such as onboarding, offboarding, access, hardware, and software requests.
* Ensure Freshservice change, access, onboarding, and offboarding records are complete and audit-ready in partnership with Information Security Risk (SOC 1 IT controls).

**Reporting, SLAs and Service Quality**

* Establish and manage SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, experience measures, and service-performance standards aligned with business expectations.
* Develop dashboards and analyze service data to identify trends, recurring issues, resource constraints, employee friction, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead recurring service reviews that translate operational data into corrective actions and measurable improvement initiatives.

**Process Improvement, Automation and AI**

* Standardize and continuously improve IT Operations processes, workflows, documentation, self-service, and knowledge practices.
* Maintain a prioritized service-improvement and automation roadmap based on service volume, employee experience, cycle time, operational risk, and business value.
* Evaluate, pilot, and operate practical uses of automation and AI that improve service quality, employee experience, technician productivity, and operational efficiency.

**Incident and Problem Management**

* Lead operational coordination of major incidents and significant service disruptions, engaging the appropriate technical teams while maintaining ownership of service restoration and stakeholder coordination. Security incidents are led by Security Operations, with Service Delivery coordinating restoration and communications.
* Develop timely firmwide service communications and concise status updates for IT leadership and business stakeholders.
* Lead post-incident reviews and problem-management activities to identify root causes, recurring issues, and corrective actions.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead and manage IT Operations staff, including engineers and co-ops, setting clear performance expectations, and coach and develop them through regular feedback, performance management, training, mentoring, and professional development.
* Strengthen team capabilities through cross-training, knowledge sharing, skills development, and succession planning.

**Competencies**

* IT Service Management and enterprise ITSM platforms, preferably Freshservice.
* People leadership, coaching, and performance management.
* Service analytics, SLAs, KPIs, XLAs, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Process improvement, workflow automation, self-service, knowledge management, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Executive-level communication and customer service in a high-expectation environment.
* Technical fluency sufficient to manage enterprise support operations and coordinate complex technical escalations.

**Requirements/Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, IT Operations, IT Service Management, end-user support, or a related discipline, preferably within a high-touch professional services environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing an IT support or service-delivery team across multiple locations.
* Experience owning or administering an enterprise ITSM platform such as Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar.
* Experience developing service levels, operational reporting, process improvements, workflow automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, analytical, organizational, communication, change-management, and customer-service skills.
* Availability outside normal business hours for significant incidents or escalations may be required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 certification or equivalent service management credential.
* Hands-on Freshservice administration experience.
* Experience in financial services, private equity, or another regulated, high-touch professional services environment.

**LOCATION: Boston, MA – Hybrid 4 days in-office. These in-office requirements may be adjusted based on the needs of the business.**

Some domestic travel to the New York and San Francisco offices is required.

Title: Corporate Services Manager
Description:
**Job description:**

Location: Dubai, UAE

Working hours: Monday to Friday 11.00 am to 8.00 pm.

**About Harrisons Sauces:**

Harrisons Sauces is a UK manufacturer of ambient sauces and condiments, based in Loughborough. We are BRC Higher Level and Halal certified, produce around 50,000 litres a day across 48 flavours, and supply leading UK foodservice businesses and 22 brand partners. We sell direct to consumers and trade through our Shopify Plus store and Amazon, and we are building a manufacturing site in the UAE to serve the GCC. Quality comes first in everything we do.

**The role: Corporate Services Manager (Dubai Based):**

We're looking for a hands-on finance professional to run finance and payroll across our UK and UAE businesses, build our UAE HR and recruitment function from the ground up, and support hiring in the UK. It's a rare chance to shape the back office of a growing two-country business, working directly with the Directors.

The role at a glance

· **Reports to:** The Directors

· **Manages:** Our bookkeeper, with room to grow a team

· **Based:** Dubai office, with UK and UAE site visits

· **Covers:** Finance, payroll, HR and recruitment

What you'll do

**Finance (UK and UAE)**

- Month-end close and management accounts

- Group consolidation and intercompany reconciliation

- 13-week cash forecast, credit control, payment runs

- Budgets, reforecasts and margin analysis

- VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, e-invoicing and filings.

**Payroll (UK and UAE)**

- Weekly UK payroll for c.100 staff

- PAYE, NI, RTI, pensions and statutory payments

- Monthly UAE payroll through WPS

- Leave pay, gratuity and final settlements

- Payroll reconciled and reported to the Directors.

**HR and recruitment (UAE**)

* Plan UAE headcount with the Directors

* Hire end to end, in-house: advert to offer

* Visas, Emirates ID, medicals and renewals

* Contracts, onboarding, probation and reviews

* UAE HR policies, handbook and secure records

**Recruitment support (UK)**

- Write and post adverts; manage job boards

- Screen CVs and schedule interviews

- Right-to-work checks, references and offers

- Hand new starters to payroll and onboarding

- Report time to hire and agency spend

**Systems:** finance owner of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for both businesses.

Your first 90 days

· **Days 1-30:** learn our ledgers, payroll and close in both countries; take over line management of the Bookkeeper.

· **Days 31-60:** deliver the Directors' monthly pack and a 13-week cash forecast; run both payrolls.

· **Days 61-90:** launch UAE hiring and visas; publish the UAE employee handbook.

**What you'll bring**

Essential

· ACCA, CIMA or ACA, or qualified by experience

· 5+ years' hands-on finance: month-end, VAT, multi-entity

· UK or UAE payroll experience

· 2+ years' UAE HR: visas, labour law, onboarding

· End-to-end recruitment without agencies

· Has managed people; advanced Excel and an ERP

**Nice to have**

o Experience in both the UK and UAE

o UAE Corporate Tax and e-invoicing

o Food, FMCG or manufacturing background

o Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

o CIPD or a UAE HR qualification

o Arabic; UAE driving license

**What We offer:**

Salary: AED 12,000–14,000/month based on experience

Annual Review: Performance-based salary review

Leave: 30 days annual leave + UAE public holidays

Visa: Employer-sponsored UAE employment visa

Medical: Comprehensive medical insurance

Gratuity: End-of-service gratuity per UAE Labour Law

**Hiring Process:**

-Apply with a CV and a short cover note

-Screening call: 30 minutes, by phone or video

-Interview with the Directors, including a short practical exercise.

Pay: AED12,000.00 - AED14,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Senior Solution Architect - Core Networks
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
At Capgemini Engineering, we are shaping the future of mission-critical connectivity across the globe. Our Connectivity & Network Engineering teams are at the heart of next-generation telecom transformation, delivering resilient, secure, and scalable core network platforms for some of the most demanding environments in the world. In Al-Khobar, we are growing our team of senior technical leaders who can own architecture decisions, drive multi-vendor integration, and lead high-performing engineering teams. If you are a seasoned core network architect who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and strategic leadership, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional
**Lead Core Network Architect**
to own the architecture and technical leadership of mobile core networks for private mission-critical connectivity platforms. You will define end-to-end core architecture strategies, lead complex multi-vendor integrations, and serve as the principal technical authority across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains — ensuring every solution is resilient, scalable, and built to the highest standards of carrier-grade reliability.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Architecting and owning end-to-end mobile core network solutions across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains, including subscriber management, policy and charging frameworks, and gateway functions, ensuring carrier-grade resilience and scalability for mission-critical private network environments
* Defining comprehensive core network architecture strategies including capacity planning, redundancy models, and geo-resilience designs, translating complex SLA requirements into robust, future-proof technical solutions that meet the highest standards of availability and performance
* Leading multi-vendor integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains, managing technical interdependencies and ensuring seamless end-to-end interoperability across the full network stack in large-scale deployment programs
* Producing high-quality High Level Design (HLD) and Low Level Design (LLD) documentation, operational runbooks, and technical reference architectures, ensuring that all solutions are thoroughly documented and ready for operational handover
* Driving vendor technical and relationship management, acting as the primary technical interface with key technology partners, evaluating vendor capabilities, influencing roadmaps, and ensuring alignment with program objectives and customer requirements
* Leading customer engagement activities at a senior technical level, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders, presenting architectural recommendations with clarity and confidence, and translating complex technical concepts into business-aligned outcomes
* Managing and mentoring the core network engineering team, providing technical guidance, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, and developing the next generation of core network talent within the organization
* Supporting deployment, performance optimization, and acceptance activities, providing hands-on technical leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure every solution meets design intent, performance benchmarks, and operational readiness criteria

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a technically exceptional and strategically minded core network leader who brings deep domain expertise, proven delivery experience, and the gravitas to lead in complex, high-stakes environments.
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in telecom core network architecture, with a strong and demonstrable background in mission-critical network environments and a proven track record of leading large-scale, complex core network programs from architecture through to deployment
* Deep technical expertise across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS technologies, including thorough knowledge of subscriber management, policy and charging systems, gateway functions, and the end-to-end mobile core architecture in both standalone and non-standalone 5G configurations
* Extensive experience leading large-scale, multi-vendor core network deployments, with the ability to manage complex technical interdependencies, drive vendor alignment, and ensure seamless integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains
* Strong proficiency in IP networking, routing protocols, and security controls, with the ability to design and validate transport and security architectures that underpin mission-critical core network platforms with uncompromising reliability
* Demonstrated ability to translate SLA requirements into robust technical solutions, with experience producing HLD/LLD documentation, operational runbooks, and capacity and geo-resilience strategies for carrier-grade network environments
* Proven senior stakeholder management and customer engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, influence architectural decisions, and communicate complex technical strategies with clarity and authority
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with experience building, guiding, and mentoring core network engineering teams in fast-paced, multicultural, and high-pressure delivery environments
* Experience working in or with KSA-based telecom operators or service providers is highly advantageous, with familiarity of the regional deployment landscape, operational expectations, and the strategic connectivity priorities aligned to Vision 2030

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

* Career acceleration programs — From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise.
* Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services — Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleashing their R&D potential to develop smart products and services of tomorrow.
* Dedicated innovation labs — We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum.
* Engineering Horizons — A global conference crafted exclusively for Capgemini Engineering colleagues, where excellence takes center stage. Immerse yourself in opportunities to showcase your talents and connect with the brightest minds in engineering across the planet.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Title: Head of Customer Success & Commercial Operations – AI-Driven
Description:
**About Crisalix**

Crisalix is a global technology company providing advanced 3D and 4D aesthetic simulation and practice growth solutions to plastic surgeons, aesthetic practitioners and clinics worldwide.

We are looking for an
**exceptional, results-driven leader**
with a proven track record of transforming Customer Success organisations, accelerating commercial performance and leveraging AI to achieve operational excellence.

* Lead, develop and scale high-performing international Customer Success teams.
* Drive customer adoption, retention, recurring revenue growth and commercial performance.
* Transform business operations through AI, automation and innovative working methods.
* Optimise customer lifecycle management, commercial processes and CRM effectiveness.
* Establish a strong performance culture based on accountability, measurable results and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate across commercial, product and technology teams to accelerate growth and scalability.



**Candidate Profile**

* **Outstanding track record in B2B SaaS**
  , ideally in value-enhancing solutions, with demonstrated success improving customer retention, revenue and operational performance.
* **Proven experience transforming and scaling Customer Success organisations**
  , with significant, measurable achievements.
* Strong, hands-on leadership skills and experience managing international teams.
* **Practical AI and automation expertise**
  , with successful implementation of solutions delivering tangible business results.
* Entrepreneurial, commercially driven and execution-oriented, with the ability to challenge established practices and deliver change.

4. Ensure completion and submission of daily operational reports, route logs, attendance records, and other required documentation.

5. Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.

6. Escalate incidents, safety concerns, vehicle issues, and other critical operational matters promptly.

7. Support project planning, resource allocation, and operational performance tracking.

We are seeking an experienced and highly organised PMO Manager to lead and oversee Project Management Office (PMO) functions within a large-scale, complex operational environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and maintaining effective project governance frameworks, overseeing project planning and performance monitoring, coordinating multiple workstreams, and ensuring that projects are delivered in line with approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and strategic objectives. This role requires a strong understanding of PMO methodologies, project controls, risk management, resource planning, reporting, and stakeholder engagement. The PMO Manager will work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and project teams to provide visibility on project performance, identify potential challenges, and drive effective decision-making.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* PMO Governance & Framework Management
* Establish, implement, and maintain PMO policies, procedures, governance frameworks, and project management standards.
* Ensure consistency in project management methodologies, processes, documentation, and reporting across all workstreams.
* Develop and maintain project governance structures, approval workflows, escalation procedures, and decision-making frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with established project management standards and organisational requirements.
* Continuously review and improve PMO processes to enhance efficiency, accountability, and project delivery.
* Project Planning & Performance Monitoring
* Oversee the development, consolidation, and monitoring of integrated project plans and master schedules.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, critical paths, and key deadlines.
* Monitor progress against approved project plans and identify deviations, delays, and potential delivery risks.
* Coordinate with project managers and workstream leads to ensure timely execution of activities.
* Ensure project objectives, deliverables, and timelines remain aligned with overall strategic priorities.
* Monitor project performance through KPIs and other relevant performance indicators.
* Reporting & Management Information
* Lead the preparation and consolidation of regular project status reports, executive dashboards, and management presentations.
* Provide senior management with accurate and timely visibility of project progress, performance, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Develop reporting templates, tracking tools, and performance measurement systems.
* Analyse project data and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of information reported across different departments and workstreams.
* Prepare progress summaries and highlight critical matters requiring management intervention.
* Risk, Issue & Change Management
* Establish and maintain project risk and issue registers.
* Identify potential project risks, operational challenges, and delivery bottlenecks.
* Coordinate the development and monitoring of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Ensure risks and issues are escalated through the appropriate governance channels.
* Monitor project changes, assess their potential impact on scope, timelines, resources, and budgets, and ensure appropriate approvals are obtained.
* Track corrective actions and ensure accountability for their timely resolution.
* Resource & Budget Oversight
* Monitor resource allocation and utilisation across projects and workstreams.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to identify resource gaps and potential capacity constraints.
* Support project budget tracking, expenditure monitoring, and financial performance reporting.
* Identify potential budget variances and highlight areas requiring corrective action.
* Ensure resources are aligned with project priorities, operational requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination
* Act as a central coordination point between senior management, project managers, department heads, and key stakeholders.
* Facilitate project review meetings, governance meetings, and progress discussions.
* Ensure clear communication of project priorities, responsibilities, decisions, and action items.
* Follow up with workstream leads to ensure agreed actions and deliverables are completed within established deadlines.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and support the resolution of cross-functional challenges.
* Ensure alignment between different departments and project teams.
* Documentation & Project Controls
* Oversee the maintenance of comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, reports, risk registers, action logs, and decision records.
* Ensure appropriate document control, version management, and reporting processes are followed.
* Maintain centralised project trackers and ensure information is regularly updated.
* Monitor project deliverables against agreed scope, quality requirements, and timelines.
* Ensure proper records are maintained to support project reviews, audits, and management decisions.

**Required Skills**

* PMO Governance: Strong understanding of PMO structures, project governance frameworks, methodologies, and standard operating procedures.
* Project Planning & Scheduling: Ability to develop, review, consolidate, and monitor integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and dependencies.
* Project Controls: Knowledge of project performance tracking, progress measurement, schedule management, and variance analysis.
* Risk & Issue Management: Ability to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate project risks and operational issues.
* Reporting & Data Analysis: Strong ability to consolidate complex information into clear management reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.
* Budget & Resource Monitoring: Understanding of project budget tracking, resource allocation, utilisation, and cost control.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to coordinate across multiple departments, manage expectations, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Change Management: Understanding of scope management, change requests, impact assessments, and approval processes.
* Documentation & Controls: Strong knowledge of project documentation, reporting standards, action tracking, and document control.

Software & Tools
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Microsoft Project or equivalent project scheduling tools.
* Power BI or similar reporting and dashboard platforms.
* Primavera P6 would be an advantage.
* Microsoft SharePoint, Teams, and other project collaboration tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Management, or a related discipline.
* Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.

**Experience Requirement**

* Minimum 8-10 years of relevant professional experience in project management, PMO, project controls, or programme management.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or leading PMO functions within large-scale, complex, or multi-stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record in establishing PMO governance frameworks, reporting structures, project controls, and performance monitoring processes.
* Strong experience coordinating multiple projects, departments, or workstreams simultaneously.
* Experience working with senior management and providing executive-level reporting and project performance insights.
* Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, risk management, change control, and resource management.
* Experience in large-scale events, major programmes, infrastructure, government, or complex operational environments would be an advantage.

Title: Restoration Manager
Description:
**RESTORATION MANAGER**

  
  

**About telMAX Inc.:**

  

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  
  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

  

The Restoration Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all restoration activities associated with TelMAX’s Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) construction program. This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

  
  

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

  

Restoration Management

  

  
* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
  
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
  
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
  
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
  
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
  
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  

  
  

Vendor Management

  

  
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
  
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
  
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
  
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
  
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
  
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
  
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.
  

  
  

Field Coordination & Quality

  

  
* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
  
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
  
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
  
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
  
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
  
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.
  

  
  

Project Tracking & Reporting

  

  
* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
    
    
  + Outstanding restoration items
    
  + Vendor assignments
    
  + Target completion dates
    
  + Aging of outstanding items
    
  + Deficiencies and rework
    
  + Municipal inspection status

* Identify operational challenges and recommend effective solutions to enhance HR service delivery.

**Pre-Opening People & Culture Management**

* Coordinate the establishment of HR operational systems, processes, documentation, and reporting structures.

* Review employment offers, contracts, and joining documentation for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain recruitment reports and provide regular hiring updates to the People & Culture Manager.
* Support workforce planning, internal mobility, and talent development initiatives.

* Provide guidance on employee relations matters, workplace policies, and Saudi Labor Law requirements.
* Support grievance handling, disciplinary procedures, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure employee relations processes are conducted fairly, consistently, and in accordance with applicable regulations.
* Advise department heads on appropriate HR procedures and employee management practices.
* Monitor employment contract compliance, probation periods, resignations, and termination procedures.

* Support Saudization monitoring and compliance with applicable workforce localization requirements.

* Ensure accuracy of employee data within HR and payroll systems.
* Coordinate employee benefits administration, medical insurance, and employment-related entitlements.

* Support a workplace culture that reflects the resort's luxury hospitality values.

Title: Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager
Description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager, you will help deliver the core infrastructure behind Microsoft's online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Azure. Our infrastructure spans over 200 datacenters and 1 million servers, supporting more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. With a focus on environmental sustainability, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands, maintaining Microsoft's position as a world-class cloud provider.

Data Center Operations Construction (DCOC) delivers complex construction and retrofit programs inside live, operational datacenters. The work spans capacity additions, mechanical and electrical equipment replacement, end-of-life remediation, network and deployment enablement, and first-of-kind retrofits, all executed without interrupting the customer availability the sites exist to provide.

The Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager owns the Operations Construction portfolio across a group of assigned metros. Where metro program managers deliver the projects in front of them, this role decides what that portfolio contains: which work advances, which is deferred, which is stopped, and in what order, across metros competing for the same capital, outage windows, vendor capacity, and site operations bandwidth. Accountability sits with the health of the multi-metro portfolio as a whole rather than with any single project inside it.

The role leads the program managers and contract construction and safety managers working across those metros, and is measured on their capability and consistency as much as on delivered projects. It carries the most complex work in its portfolio, including first-of-kind retrofits in live space where no established execution method exists, and converts that work into standards and practice the wider program adopts. Reporting to the Director of Operations Construction, this position represents DCOC to site leadership, engineering, commissioning, and enterprise customer programs.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead portfolio strategy and prioritization across assigned metros, translating capacity, availability, sustainability, and business objectives into executable construction plans while balancing capital, resources, outage windows, vendor capacity, and operational constraints.
* Own portfolio delivery and governance across safety, scope, schedule, budget, commercial performance, and risk, including forecasting, change management, project controls, commissioning readiness, operational turnover, and closeout.
* Exercise independent judgment on complex, high-impact programs, assessing project viability, investment trade-offs, emerging risks, and delivery confidence, and personally leading the most complex, first-of-kind, or highest-risk initiatives when warranted.
* Lead and develop program capability across the portfolio, providing direction, coaching, and technical leadership to program managers and contract construction and safety teams while building workforce capacity, bench strength, and consistent execution practices.
* Develop and scale construction standards and program practices, establishing execution methods for first-of-kind work and translating lessons learned, root cause findings, project controls, and performance data into repeatable standards and playbooks adopted across metros and regions.
* Influence senior stakeholders and delivery partners across site operations, engineering, commissioning, supply chain, security, legal, and enterprise programs, presenting portfolio performance, investment needs, forecasts, and risk in terms that enable clear business decisions and resolve competing priorities.
* Model and champion a safety-first, accountable culture while embodying Microsoft’s culture and values, holding internal teams and external partners to high standards for safety, security, availability, operational excellence, and responsible delivery.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments OR equivalent experience

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 15+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 17+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.
* Applicable certifications: Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications.
* 12+ years of experience in construction management, datacenter operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or program management
* 6+ years of experience managing complex project or program portfolios across multiple sites, metros, or regions
* Experience delivering construction in live, mission-critical environments while maintaining operational availability
* Experience leading first-of-kind, accelerated, or high-risk projects with accountability for safety, cost, schedule, and risk
* Experience leading and developing teams, including employees, contractors, and cross-functional resources
* Experience managing portfolio governance, commercial performance, vendors, project controls, KPIs, and executive reporting
* PE, PMP, CCM, DBIA, LEED, CQM, ITIL, or equivalent certification preferred

Title: Customer Service Lead Representitive - Cigna Healthcare
Description:
About Cigna Healthcare
  
  
Cigna Healthcare is a global health service company dedicated to transforming healthcare. With roots in the U.S. and operations in over 30 countries, we serve more than 180 million customers and patients worldwide. Ranked 14th on the Fortune 500 in 2026, Cigna is recognised as one of the most trusted and influential names in the industry.
  
Our mission is to improve the health, well-being, and peace of mind of those we serve.
  
Youll join a globally recognised organisation where trust, clear communication, and a positive culture shape how we work. Our leaders are consistent, approachable, and supportive, helping you maintain balance while doing meaningful work.
  
We look for people who thrive in collaborative environments, care about meaningful change, and want to grow in a company that puts people first. At Cigna Healthcare, your work contributes to better care experiences and supports customers through important moments in their lives.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Customer Service Lead Representative plays a critical role in supporting the delivery of exceptional customer service across member, provider, client, and broker interactions while providing day-to-day operational support within the contact centre.
  
This role serves as a senior technical and operational resource, managing complex enquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery activities while helping ensure service continuity, workload visibility, and adherence to service standards.
  
Working closely with the Customer Service Manager, the Customer Service Lead Representative provides floor support, operational guidance, and knowledge sharing to Customer Service Representatives, helping to drive service quality and operational effectiveness.
  
This is not a formal people management role and does not include employee performance management, disciplinary authority, or approval responsibilities.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  

* Investigate and resolve complex customer enquiries, complaints, appeals, and escalated service issues across calls, emails, and written correspondence.
* Act as the primary operational and technical escalation point for cases requiring advanced research, coordination, policy interpretation, or procedural guidance.
* Interpret policy provisions, benefits, procedures, and operational requirements to determine appropriate solutions and escalation pathways.
* Maintain end-to-end ownership of escalated cases, ensuring timely resolution, accurate documentation, proactive follow-up, and clear customer communication.
* Support service recovery activities by managing customer expectations, coordinating corrective actions, and ensuring customer concerns are effectively addressed.
* Collaborate with Health Plans, Claims, Approvals, Service Centres, Providers, IT, and other stakeholders to facilitate prompt resolution of customer issues.
* Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders while supporting a seamless customer experience.
* Monitor service queues, pending inventories, backlogs, ageing cases, and service-level risks, escalating concerns appropriately to the Customer Service Supervisor.
* Support workload coordination and operational prioritisation based on customer impact, service commitments, and business requirements.
* Ensure effective shift handovers through accurate communication of priority cases, unresolved issues, and operational updates.
* Assist with the preparation of operational updates, service-level reports, escalation summaries, workload status reports, and risk visibility reporting.
* Identify recurring service issues, root causes, process gaps, and customer experience challenges, providing recommendations for improvement.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives, onboarding activities, refresher training sessions, process enhancements, and quality improvement programmes.
* Support quality assurance reviews, compliance activities, audits, and operational governance requirements.
* Maintain accurate customer records and ensure all activities comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, confidentiality obligations, information security standards, and data privacy requirements.
* Continue supporting core customer service activities during periods of high contact volumes, operational peaks, and business-critical events.
* Provide designated operational support coverage during the absence of the Customer Service Manager while remaining within the roles defined authority limits.

What Youll Bring
  
  

* Diploma or Bachelors degree, preferably in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Customer Service Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in customer service, member services, client services, call centre/contact centre operations, or a related customer support environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex customer enquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery situations.
* Experience within the healthcare insurance industry is strongly preferred; experience within insurance, managed care, banking, financial services, or third-party administration environments will also be considered.
* Strong understanding of contact centre operations, service levels, escalation management, workload prioritisation, case ownership, and queue management principles.
* Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain service quality under pressure.
* Fluency in written and spoken Arabic and English.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts in line with business requirements.

Skills

* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage professionally and empathetically with customers and stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with sound judgement and professionalism in sensitive or challenging situations.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with the ability to make decisions within established guidelines.
* Excellent organisational, prioritisation, and time-management skills.
* Ability to guide, coach, and influence colleagues through expertise and collaboration rather than formal authority.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* High levels of accountability, ownership, and attention to detail.

Technical / Functional Skills
  
  

* Strong knowledge of customer service operations, escalation management, complaint resolution, and service recovery principles.
* Ability to accurately interpret insurance policies, customer benefits, procedures, and operational requirements.
* Understanding of contact centre performance metrics, including service levels, turnaround times, quality scores, response times, customer satisfaction, and productivity measures.
* Experience monitoring queues, workloads, pending inventories, backlogs, and operational performance risks.
* Ability to identify trends, root causes, operational gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience using CRM systems, customer service platforms, and case management tools.
* Strong multitasking capability within a fast-paced, high-volume operational environment.
* Ability to maintain accurate case records, escalation logs, operational updates, and customer interaction documentation.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Knowledge of healthcare insurance operations, medical terminology, and healthcare service delivery models.
* Experience supporting onboarding, floor support, knowledge-sharing, quality calibration, or process improvement initiatives.
* Experience preparing service-level reports, operational dashboards, workload updates, or escalation reporting.
* Familiarity with complaint management frameworks, quality improvement methodologies, and continuous improvement practices.

Why Join Us
  
  

* Competitive salary aligned with market benchmarks.
* Multicultural and collaborative working environment.
* Private Medical Insurance.
* Employee Wellbeing Benefits.
* Educational Development Program supporting continuous learning and professional growth.

Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Title: Head of Corporate Finance & Credit Control
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182711

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

**Overview of the role**
  
Lead the corporate finance, new business and credit control agenda for Automotive across UAE and overseas operations. You will safeguard liquidity, optimize working capital and evaluate strategic investments while maintaining robust credit governance. This role balances commercial growth with funding capacity, collectability and risk-adjusted returns.

  

**What you will do**
  

* Lead liquidity planning, cash-flow forecasting and working-capital improvements across inventory, receivables and payables.
* Partner with Treasury, Tax, FP&A and business teams on cash conversion, funding requirements and currency exposures.
* Evaluate investments and capital expenditure through financial modelling, valuation, scenario analysis and post-investment reviews.
* Develop business cases for new businesses, market entries, partnerships, joint ventures and acquisitions, supporting due diligence, transaction structuring and approvals.
* Own credit-risk governance, including customer assessment, credit limits, payment terms, securities and exception management.
* Improve receivables and collections performance through portfolio reviews, dispute resolution and recovery escalation.
* Maintain effective policies, controls, approval standards and management reporting.
* Lead and develop the team, driving digitalization, analytics and continuous improvement.

  

**Required skills to be successful**
  

* Strong expertise in corporate finance, cash-flow forecasting, working-capital management and investment appraisal.
* Advanced financial modelling, valuation and business-case development capabilities.
* Sound knowledge of credit assessment, security structures, receivables analytics and collections governance.
* Commercial judgement and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear executive recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation-support skills.
* Collaborative leadership, constructive challenge, integrity and delivery discipline.

  

**About the team**
  
Reporting to the General Manager – Divisional Finance, you will lead a team with five direct reports within Automotive Finance, supporting UAE and overseas operations. You will work closely with the Automotive CFO, business leaders, FP&A, Group Finance, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Internal Audit and shared services, alongside external advisers, lenders and partners where relevant.

  

**What equips you for the role**
  

* Chartered Accountant, CPA, CFA, ACCA, MBA in Finance, or an equivalent professional qualification.
* 10 to 15 years of relevant finance experience, including leadership responsibility in corporate finance, treasury-facing roles, investments, new business, credit risk or collections governance.
* Demonstrated experience in financial modelling, business-case development, liquidity management, senior approvals and cross-functional collaboration.
* Treasury exposure covering cash forecasting, currency exposures and funding requests to a group treasury function.
* Experience owning or governing a customer credit framework, including risk appetite, limits, securities, delegated authority and portfolio reporting.
* Working knowledge of IFRS, funding concepts, transaction evaluation and enterprise finance systems; advanced Excel and SAP experience preferred.
* Experience in automotive, distribution, retail, financial services or another asset- and working-capital-intensive sector is advantageous.

  

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

Description:

**Job Description**

**About Us**

TP is a worldwide leader in client experience management, digital business services, and strategic contact center outsourcing. With more than 500,000 employees globally, TP combines high-performing on-site infrastructure with cutting-edge remote delivery models, providing support across 300 languages and dialects. Consistently recognized in Fortune Magazine's Top 25 World's Best Workplaces in partnership with Great Place to Work®, TP empowers enterprise technology partners to scale strategic go-to-market and partner success operations seamlessly across premier global markets.

**Our Work Culture**

At TP, we remain true to our core values of integrity, respect, professionalism, innovation, and commitment:

* **Autonomous:** We encourage and trust your independent judgment to prioritize high-leverage interventions across your portfolio.
* **Progressive Work Environment:** Clear vertical and horizontal growth pathways backed by structured coaching and tier-readiness programs.
* **Flexible & Impact-Driven:** We emphasize tangible outcomes, commercial retention, and partner health over activity volume.
* **Innovative:** Every idea matters—we empower operators to build new 0-to-1 playbooks and optimize operational workflows.
* **Inclusive:** A collaborative global culture where diverse perspectives are celebrated and everyone wins together.

**About the job**

As a Partner Customer Success Manager (PCSM), you are the dedicated post-sales commercial owner and strategic platform advisor for a high-value portfolio of 150–250 accounting firms, bookkeepers, and fractional CFOs. Within our partner GTM model, this segment represents highly defensible recurring revenue and the foundation of end-client subscription adoption. In this role, you protect the partner book against competitor migration, accelerate multi-product adoption (including Core Accounting, Payroll, Payments, Expense Management, Time, and Accountant Suites), and empower advisory firms to scale their practices efficiently.  
  
You operate through a proven Scaled Success motion—pairing an annual scheduled value cadence with real-time, signal-triggered 1:1 interventions and digital 1:many leverage. This is a high-impact role combining consultative account stewardship, data-driven prioritization, and authentic domain credibility.

*Competitive annual base salary, 60,000 Annual CAD, commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive performance-based incentive programs tied to portfolio retention, expansion ARR, and partner health metrics with an annual OTE of up to 10%.*

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

The Partner Customer Success Manager executes across four strategic pillars to drive partner health, revenue retention, and ecosystem expansion:

* **Scaled Portfolio Management & Cadence:** Own and manage a designated portfolio of 150–250 accounting, bookkeeping, and advisory firms as their primary post-sales point of contact; execute structured annual value reviews supported by automated mid-year health check-ins.
* **Signal-Triggered Rapid Intervention:** Monitor CRM health metrics, engagement indicators, and platform telemetry in real time; proactively intervene 1:1 whenever risk triggers fire (e.g., stalled client onboarding, platform usage drops, or competitor migration signals).
* **Revenue Defense & Churn Prevention:** Protect whole-book partner relationships to prevent silent attrition of entire underlying client subscriptions, developing proactive recovery playbooks for accounts showing disengagement or decline.
* **Client Book Migration & Multi-Product Attach:** Partner with firm principals to migrate additional client books onto the cloud platform; drive organic expansion and cross-sell across ecosystem solutions including Payroll, Payments, Corporate Cards/Expense Management, Bill Pay, and Accountant Suites.
* **Practice Onboarding & Tier Progression:** Lead structured onboarding from initial introduction to accelerate time-to-first-value; coach accounting professionals through certification programs (e.g., ProAdvisor) and tier progression milestones.
* **Campaign Targeting & Digital Leverage:** Deploy pre-built expansion toolkits, educational webinars, and digital 1:many campaigns targeted at qualifying client segments across the portfolio to drive self-serve adoption.
* **Dedicated Partner Escalation Route:** Serve as the trusted, authoritative single point of contact for complex partner operational inquiries; coordinate with Technical Support, Approvals/KYB, and Risk teams to deliver industry-leading response resolution.
* **Voice of the Partner Channel:** Act as internal partner champion by surfacing recurring workflow bottlenecks, data-mapping gaps, and product enhancements directly to Product, Engineering, and RevOps leadership.

**Job Requirements (Minimum skills and technical requirements)**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree, College diploma, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Experience:** 1+ years in Customer Success, Partner Success, Account Management, or B2B Client Engagement within B2B SaaS, FinTech, or Cloud software (candidates with 1+ years in a high-volume, scaled CS motion demonstrating exceptional commercial results are strongly considered).
* **Domain Knowledge:** Demonstrated working understanding of accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals, compliance workflows, and practice management operations.
* **Portfolio Management at Scale:** Proven track record managing a large book of business (150+ accounts) using smart prioritization, automated triggers, and digital leverage rather than unsustainable blanket high-touch.
* **Commercial Track Record:** Demonstrated success in driving product adoption, expanding recurring revenue (ARR/NRR), and safeguarding retention within a matrixed enterprise organization.
* **Tooling & Data Literacy:** Proficiency with enterprise CRM and CS tooling (Salesforce, ChurnZero, Gainsight) and analytics platforms; adept at interpreting health scores, telemetry data, and task queues to guide daily outreach.
* **Bilingual Communication preferred (Canada Hires):** Exceptional professional verbal and written communication skills in both English and French (minimum CEFR C1 proficiency required).

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Balances consultative advocacy with strong commercial instincts to identify cross-sell opportunities, run business reviews, and articulate ROI to firm owners.
* **Data-Driven Prioritization:** Ability to filter signal from noise across large datasets to invest high-touch effort where it drives maximum retention and growth impact.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Skilled at motivating external partner principals to adopt new workflows while coordinating internal cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Support, Approvals) to resolve blockers.
* **Accountability & Resilience:** Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ownership over commercial outcomes; maintains composure, focus, and empathy under high-volume demands.
* **Adaptive & Solution-Oriented Communication:** Smoothly transitions between strategic advisory conversations with firm leaders and practical, technical workflow troubleshooting with operational staff.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Accounting Certifications:** Foundational qualification in accounting or bookkeeping (e.g., CPA, CA, CFA, ACCA, ICB, CIPP) or official ProAdvisor certification.
* **Platform Experience:** Hands-on experience with QuickBooks, Float, Xero, or comparable financial management, spend management, and ERP software ecosystems.

* Comprehensive paid 4-week product and onboarding training, plus generous paid annual leave.
* Continuous professional learning through progressive, tenure-specific certification and enablement programs.
* Competitive base salary complemented by performance-based incentive and quarterly reward structures.
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, plus Employee and Family Assistance Programs (EFAP).
* Vibrant, collaborative workplace with dedicated Rewards & Recognition celebrations.

Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 9-hour shift (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM local time). No weekend or overnight rotations required.

Toronto Office (75 Eglinton Ave East, Toronto) – Onsite

These tools augment our recruitment team and do not replace human judgment. Accessibility & Accommodations: Teleperformance welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the assessment and interview process.

**Be One of Our People:**
