Title: Assistant Front Store Manager, Hourly Full Time Day
Description:
Join a locally owned and operated store to help deliver health, beauty and convenience services in your community, and keep the customer at the centre of everything you do.

**Why this role is important?**

**SUMMARY:**  
To assist the Front Store Manager (FSM) in managing the human, physical and financial resources of the store and in ensuring that store objectives are achieved by focusing on improving product flow from the backroom to the sales floor.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**OPERATIONS:**

Maintains Store Standards to optimize customer experience, drive customer traffic, and positively impact store profitability

Works with Management Team to ensure Store Standards are in effect 100% of the time, including the backroom

To help manage in conjunction with the FSM, labour scheduling and leverages Work Force Management (WFM) to maximize labour productivity

Ensures staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the business

**HUMAN RESOURCES:**

Complies with Human Resources Standards

To help with hiring in conjunction with the FSM, Hires and/or supports hiring for all departments, excluding Pharmacy

Maintains wage administration within SLPH guidelines

Drives Blue Culture, engagement, and leads and motivates staff through leading by our Core Values

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

Planning, Judgement and Decision Making

Planning and preparation for Inventory Management

Use judgment and decision-making skills to control expenses

Provides effective leadership and ongoing mentorship and ensures development of all staff

Efficient time management skills

Able to prioritize activities quickly in response to changing initiatives

Effective organization and planning skills

**EXPERIENCE:**

Previous retail management experience

Demonstrated ability to drive the business, led by example and support corporate programs

Works effectively with management team

Superior interpersonal, coaching and communication skills

Business and financial acumen

Relationship builder with key internal and external agencies

J2WRTL  
J2WFSM

**Why work in a Shoppers Drug Mart store?**

Each store has an Associate-Owner, so you will work for a local business owner while having the support of a national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, flexible and varied schedules, competitive pay and online learning through Academy.

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your patients, co-workers, customers and community.

Associate Owners in the Shoppers Drug Mart network recognize Canada's diversity as an opportunity to better serve their communities, and strive to reflect the nation’s evolving diversity in the products they sell, the people they hire, and the culture they create in their stores. Through personal selling, leadership, and coaching, the SM will champion a People First store environment that promotes diversity and inclusion, the development of life-time relationships with customers and the delivery of a best-in-class customer experience.

Communicates performance expectations and ensures all team members understand the impact of their performance on company success. Demonstrates the highest level of professionalism to customers and team members by displaying integrity and honesty at all times, and by conducting himself/herself in a manner that will influence and earn the respect of team members and management. Displays a positive and enthusiastic attitude so as to inspire and motive others to achieve and attain goals.

**Customer Obsession:**

Responsible for ensuring team members, and self, deliver an exceptional customer experience every time through training, customer outreach, communication and clear expectations. Empowers team members to respond to and resolve customer issues within established parameters and drives a high level of customer service through follow-up and customer outreach

Compiles and follows up on customer requests.

**Critical Thinking & Innovative Action:**

Attains sales projections and sales quotas as set by the Company and develops strategies to maximizes both personal and team members sales potential while achieving goals. Reviews and analyzes reports. Identifies trends, opportunities and available resources and develops plans to address issues. Keeps management informed of the marketing, merchandising, and payment programs of the competitors within the area and advises management new or changing merchandise and services needs and excesses. Implements initiatives that will change behaviors to produce results. Demonstrates an ability to motivate, persuade, and influence the actions of others.

Demonstrates a commitment to the Company’s People First vision. Responsible for the selection and development of talent to drive store growth. Communicates performance expectations, sets actionable goals for self and others and monitors progress and performance against desired behaviors. Maintains open communication with team members and management, encouraging participation and idea sharing. Title: Senior Manager Supply Chain, MENA
Description:
**For A Better You**  
  
At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.  
  
We constantly strive for innovation, while transforming and improving the online shopping experience for our customers. We believe that individually we are incredible, but when we come together, our growth is infinite. In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.  
  
Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

**Travel Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related discipline or equivalent additional experience required

With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

**About The Team**

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Warehouse Process Optimization and Efficiency Improvement:** Analyze warehouse operation processes (inbound, inventory, outbound), optimize warehouse layout, operation routes and equipment configuration, introduce automation tools to improve warehouse space efficiency and labor efficiency, reduce operation costs and ensure smooth and efficient warehouse operations.

Title: Sr. Manager Warehouse and Distribution
Description:

The Senior Manager, Warehouse & Logistics leads the safe, accurate and efficient movement of products through Perfect Sports Canada Inc.’s Aurora distribution facility. Working closely with the Warehouse Manager, Sales, Finance, manufacturing partners and Quality, the Senior Manager translates business priorities into practical operating plans, supports daily execution and resolves issues on the warehouse floor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead receiving, storage, replenishment, picking, packing and shipping across the 50,000 sq. ft. distribution facility, including its eight dock doors; participate directly when workload or operational issues require support.

* Coordinate daily priorities with the Warehouse Manager to align people, equipment and space with order volumes, inbound deliveries and customer commitments. Provide clear handovers and timely escalation of constraints.

* Manage inbound deliveries from manufacturing partners and outbound Canadian, international and intercompany U.S. shipments; coordinate carriers, third-party logistics providers and delivery appointments.

* Monitor EDI orders through the Minotaur ERP system from receipt to dispatch. Resolve inventory, allocation and transaction exceptions with the appropriate teams and confirm orders progress within required timelines.

* Ensure fulfillment meets customer routing guides, pallet and carton specifications, labels, shipping notices and documentation requirements; investigate chargebacks and recurring service failures.

* Maintain accurate inventory quantities, locations, lot numbers and expiry dates in the ERP system; lead cycle counts, physical counts, variance investigations and approved inventory adjustments.

* Apply first-expiry-first-out or first-in-first-out controls as appropriate. Monitor aging, short-dated, damaged and slow-moving stock and recommend timely action to management.

* Coordinate replenishment and product availability with Sales, Finance and manufacturing partners. Flag shortages and excess stock early and support demand and capacity planning.

* Ensure receiving checks identify quantity discrepancies, damage and documentation gaps; record exceptions before carrier departure where practical and coordinate resolution.

* Coordinate freight bookings, bills of lading, packing lists, export and customs documentation with carriers, brokers and internal teams; verify accuracy and resolve shipment delays or claims.

* Work with Quality and the designated Quality Assurance Person to execute applicable GMP, CFIA and Health Canada procedures. Maintain lot traceability, segregation, storage conditions, sanitation and allergen controls where applicable.

* Coach and develop warehouse staff in collaboration with the Warehouse Manager and HR. **Reinforce respectful communication,** clear expectations, training completion and consistent accountability.

* Plan staffing and equipment needs against workload and budget. Obtain required management approval before temporary labour bookings, overtime commitments, freight exceptions or other spending; coordinate approved arrangements with the Warehouse Manager.

Title: Chef de service - Données et Intelligence artificielle - Responsable technique - Intégration des systèmes et solutions
Description:
**Appartenir à Air Canada, c’est appartenir à un symbole canadien, Air Canada récemment élue meilleur transporteur aérien en Amérique du Nord. Faites décoller votre carrière en vous joignant à notre équipe novatrice et diversifiée à l’avant-garde du transport aérien de passagers.**
La personne qui occupe le poste de chef de service – Données et Intelligence artificielle dirige l’intégration technique, le déploiement et les capacités de préparation à la production requises pour opérationnaliser des produits, des modèles et des agents d’IA, ainsi que des pipelines de données de soutien dans l’ensemble des environnements d’entreprise d’Air Canada. Elle veille à ce que les solutions d’IA passent d’une architecture et d’une conception technique approuvées à des phases de développement, de tests et de production de manière sécurisée, contrôlée, reproductible et de plus en plus automatisée. Elle dirige les intégrateurs de systèmes d’IA et les spécialistes – Déploiement, établit des modèles d’intégration et de déploiement réutilisables, et travaille avec les équipes de l’ingénierie de l’IA, de l’ingénierie des données, l’ingénierie des plateformes, de l’Architecture, de la Cybersécurité, des opérations infonuagiques et des Opérations de données pour obtenir des résultats de production durables. La personne qui occupe ce poste doit trouver un équilibre entre la rapidité d’ingénierie et la gouvernance d’entreprise, la stabilité opérationnelle, la traçabilité et les contrôles fondés sur les risques.
  
  
**Le poste peut-être basé à Montréal ou Toronto.**
**Responsabilités**

* Diriger l’intégration des systèmes d’IA et gérer les spécialistes responsables de la transition des solutions d’IA de conceptions approuvées vers les environnements de l’entreprise.
* S’assurer que les produits, les modèles, les agents et les API d’IA et les pipelines de données de soutien sont correctement intégrés aux plateformes d’entreprise et aux systèmes en amont et en aval.
* Superviser le déploiement et la configuration des charges de travail liées à l’IA dans l’ensemble des environnements de développement, de mise à l’essai et de production.
* Piloter l’infrastructure en tant que code, les pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, les modèles relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), notamment la promotion des applications et des modèles et la gestion des versions, des replis et de l’environnement.
* Mettre en place des modèles d’intégration, des composants de déploiement, des gabarits et des processus d’automatisation réutilisables afin de réduire les tâches d’ingénierie propres à la solution et d’accélérer l’adoption.
* Collaborer avec les chefs des Produits – Intelligence artificielle, les scientifiques des données, les ingénieurs – Intelligence artificielle, les architectes de solutions, les architectes informatiques de l’entreprise, la Cybersécurité, les opérations infonuagiques, l’ingénierie des plateformes et les Opérations de données pour traduire les conceptions en versions prêtes pour la production.
* Définir et appliquer des critères de préparation à la production, notamment en ce qui concerne la surveillance, la journalisation, les alertes, les guides d’exploitation, la documentation de soutien, les responsabilités opérationnelles et les procédures de récupération.
* S’assurer que les intégrations et les déploiements répondent aux exigences en matière d’architecture, de cybersécurité, d’infrastructure, de gouvernance des données, de protection des renseignements personnels et d’exploitation.
* Mettre en œuvre des contrôles fondés sur les risques et comprenant les points d’approbation humaine appropriés pour les solutions concernant des données sensibles, des modèles d’IA, des agents autonomes ou des décisions d’affaires importantes.
* Diriger la validation technique, la préparation de la mise en service, la vérification après le déploiement et la transition ordonnée vers un soutien opérationnel stable.
* Définir et assurer le suivi des mesures de la réussite des déploiements, de la qualité des intégrations, de l’automatisation, de la fiabilité, des remaniements et de la préparation opérationnelle.
* Déterminer les problèmes récurrents en matière d’intégration et de déploiement et améliorer les pratiques d’ingénierie, les normes et les outils réutilisables en amont.
* Gérer la demande, les priorités, la capacité, les dépendances et les engagements en matière de prestation pour la fonction d’intégration des systèmes d’intelligence artificielle.
* Diriger, encadrer et perfectionner une équipe technique à haut rendement, établir des responsabilités claires et soutenir l’avancement professionnel.
* Assurer le leadership lors de mises en œuvre complexes ou à haut risque et agir à titre de personne-ressource pour les recours hiérarchiques en ce qui concerne les problèmes d’intégration et de déploiement.
* Gérer les relations avec les partenaires technologiques et les fournisseurs externes qui complètent les capacités de prestation internes.
* Maintenir ses connaissances à jour sur les pratiques d’ingénierie liées à l’IA, à l’infonuagique, à l’intégration, au déploiement et à la production, et évaluer leur applicabilité à Air Canada.

**Qualifications**

* Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologie de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience de travail équivalente.
* Au moins sept ans d’expérience en technologies à différents échelons, dont au moins trois ans à un poste de direction d’équipes techniques au sein d’un environnement d’entreprise vaste et complexe.
* Expérience avérée de l’intégration des systèmes, de l’ingénierie infonuagique, de l’ingénierie des plateformes, du développement et de l’exploitation, de la distribution de logiciels ou des activités de production.
* Excellente compréhension des pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, du contrôle des sources à l’aide de Git, des stratégies d’embranchement, des tests automatisés, de l’infrastructure en tant que code, des pipelines de déploiement et du déploiement dans différents environnements.
* Connaissance pratique des écosystèmes de données et d’IA modernes, notamment Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure DevOps ou GitHub, des plateformes d’orchestration et des outils de déploiement de l’IA et de l’apprentissage automatique.
* Compréhension des concepts relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), au déploiement des modèles et des applications, à la gestion des versions, à l’observabilité et à la gestion du cycle de vie de la production.
* Expérience de l’intégration d’API, des pipelines de données, de services infonuagiques, des contrôles de l’identité et des accès, des applications d’entreprise et des composants dirigés par les événements.
* Excellente connaissance des pratiques de l’entreprise en ce qui a trait à l’architecture informatique, à la cybersécurité, aux changements, aux versions et à la gestion des services TI.
* Capacité avérée à établir un équilibre entre la gouvernance, les risques liés à la production et les contrôles, et la rapidité d’exécution et l’automatisation.
* Aptitudes avérées pour le leadership humain, la gestion des parties prenantes, la communication, la prise de décision et la résolution de problèmes.
* Faire preuve de ponctualité et fiabilité avérées pour favoriser la réussite globale de l’équipe dans un milieu trépidant.
* Expérience à un poste critique sur le plan opérationnel dans le secteur de l’aviation ou du transport, ou dans un autre secteur hautement réglementé, un atout.

**Conditions D’emploi**
Les candidats doivent être admissibles à travailler dans le pays concerné au moment où une offre d’emploi est présentée et sont responsables de l’obtention des permis de travail, visas ou autres autorisations nécessaires. La preuve de l’admissibilité doit être fournie avant la date de début.
  
  
**Exigences Linguistiques**

**Diversité et inclusion**
Air Canada est résolument engagée en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion et vise à créer un milieu de travail sain, accessible et gratifiant qui met en valeur la contribution unique de nos employés au succès de notre entreprise.
  
  
En tant qu'employeur qui garantit l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi, nous encourageons les candidatures les plus diverses afin de pouvoir nous doter d’un effectif varié et représentatif de nos clients et des communautés où nous vivons et offrons nos services.

Title: Senior Advisor - Technology
Description:
**Senior Advisor – Technology**

**(Bilingual Arabic & English Candidates Only)**

Partner with the Managing Director of Technology to assess what is next, guide high-impact technology initiatives and help turn sound strategic decisions into solutions that work across Al Jazeera Media Network .

**The opportunity**

AJMN is seeking a senior technology professional who can connect executive priorities with technical delivery. As Senior Advisor – Technology, you will bring independent expertise, broad perspective and practical judgement to complex technology decisions—from evaluating emerging technologies and reviewing major initiatives to advising on implementation risks and long-term direction.

You will work across the Network with senior leaders, business divisions and technical teams. Your advice will help ensure that technology investments and solutions support AJMN’s strategic priorities, operational requirements and future needs across media, broadcast and digital environments.

**What you’ll contribute:**

* Advise the Managing Director of Technology-on-technology trends, strategic choices, investment priorities and long-term direction.
* Review major initiatives, business cases, technical assessments and solution designs; offer clear, balanced recommendations.
* Guide teams through feasibility, solution selection, integration, implementation risks and post-implementation evaluation.

* Advise on architecture, governance, security, resilience, continuity and technology risk.
* Bring business stakeholders, technical teams, consultants and providers together to support well-informed decisions and successful delivery.
* Translate complex technical matters into concise executive briefings, assessments and recommendations.

**The candidate we expect to hire:**

You are a trusted, commercially aware technology advisor with the depth to engage credibly with technical specialists and the clarity to influence executive decisions. You combine strategic thinking with implementation experience and can challenge proposals constructively while keeping business and operational realities in view.

***You will bring:***

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Significant progressive experience in senior technology advisory, strategy, architecture, transformation or complex programme environments.
* A strong record of advising senior leaders and shaping decisions on complex, high-impact technology initiatives.
* The ability to assess solution designs, business cases, delivery approaches, dependencies, risks and expected outcomes.
* Broad knowledge of contemporary technology, including cloud, cybersecurity, data and analytics, automation and artificial intelligence.
* Excellent executive communication, analytical, stakeholder-engagement and problem-solving skills.
* Professional fluency in both Arabic and English, spoken and written.
  **Arabic and English are both mandatory.**

**Particularly valuable:**

Experience in media, broadcasting, digital platforms or other complex, always-on operating environments; a relevant postgraduate qualification; and experience with technology vendors, consultants or strategic partnerships.

**Why this role**

This is an opportunity to influence technology choices at Network scale and contribute to the evolution of a complex media environment. You’ll work closely with senior technology leadership, engage with diverse teams and help move promising ideas toward secure, resilient and practical implementation.

Title: Principal, International CX, Amazon Customer Service
Description:
**Description**
Come build the future of international customer experience with us. Every year, millions of customers across Amazon's global stores — from Dubai to São Paulo, Warsaw to Bangalore — experience moments where Amazon falls short. CXI's vision is to ensure every one of them — regardless of where they shop, what language they speak, or whether they ever contact us — gets an experience worthy of Amazon's promise. We do this by holding the most direct and comprehensive view of what's going wrong for customers, and driving the product, policy, and partnership changes that fix it at the root.
  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed senior product leader to join us as a Principal within the Customer Experience Improvement org (CXI) within Customer Service. You will dig deep into customer friction across all of Amazon's international stores — EU, India, MENA, LATAM, AU/ZA, and emerging markets — trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product improvements to improve CX. You will force-multiply the work of CXI's regional teams by building the frameworks, mental models, and measurement approaches they need to solve CX problems at scale — and influencing across organizations and senior leadership to drive systemic, durable change for international customers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Improve customer experience by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of friction across all international stores
* Build frameworks and mental models for solving CX gaps at scale — creating reusable approaches that force-multiply the work of CXI's regional teams across markets
* Author product strategy documents that drive alignment and investment decisions at VP and SVP level
* Define and own the metrics framework for international CX — including developing new measurement approaches that capture customer harm beyond traditional contact-based metrics, and that quantify the impact of policy and enforcement decisions on genuine customers
* Establish data-driven approaches to surface customer pain points — across human contacts, self-service, and customers who never reach CS — and drive upstream action across organizations
* Partner with product and technology teams to translate customer insights into product requirements and scalable solutions
* Partner with internal CS teams across product, quality of service, and technology to co-create the roadmap and plan for international stores — spanning self-service, associate service, and concessions — ensuring international customer needs are embedded in CS's product and tech priorities
* Work with central CXI teams — including DXI and Returns and Refunds — to embed the international lens into centrally-driven initiatives, ensuring that solutions designed at the global level reflect the realities of international customers and markets
* Partner on VP-level engagements across international markets, establishing shared CX improvement goals and joint accountability for outcomes
* Advocate for international customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations
* Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals
* Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making at senior leadership level

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* 10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
* Experience understanding product and technical requirements and interfacing with Product/Technology teams
* Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
* Experience writing strategy documents for executive audiences with clear recommendations in the midst of ambiguity
* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience owning product strategy across complex, multi-market environments
* Strong understanding of international customers, businesses, and cultures across multiple geographies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience owning technology products
* Prior experience based in or covering MENA, LATAM, EU, or South Asia markets
* Proficiency in Arabic, Spanish, French, or other non-English languages is a plus

Title: AWS Commissioning, ACx Amazon Commissioning
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. To meet the growing demand for AWS cloud computing capacity in EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer to join the team.
  
  
Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning?  
  
As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centres, Hybrid Colo's, Single Tennent Colo and Multi Tennent Colo builds . The AWS Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will be responsible for supporting vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:  
  

* Medium and low voltage power systems
* Generators
* UPS
* HVAC
* Chilled Water Systems
* Building Management systems (BMS)
* Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
* Testing and balancing
* Pumps and Hydronic systems

  
The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning, the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects.
  
  
A day in the life  
The CxE's daily focus is to ensure the commissioning quality and progress meet AWS's high standards by:  
Developing commissioning standards.  
Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.  
Organize and attend meetings highlighting AWS requirements and tracking overall build and commissioning progress and blockers.  
Performing site walks to identify installation and testing deficiencies and maintain observation logs.  
Manage on-site 3rd-party commissioning vendors to ensure coverage of all Cx-activities.  
Gather, organize, and review design and commissioning documentation.  
Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.
  
  
About the team  
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCCD organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
* 4+ years of commissioning experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
* Bachelor's degree or above in civil engineering, structural engineering, or architectural engineering from an ABET accredited program
* PE (Professional Engineer) or SE (Structural Engineer) Engineering license
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Knowledge of building codes, regulations, and standards including IBC (International Building Code) and ASCE (American Society of Civil Engineers)
* Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
* Experience in commissioning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
* Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance

Title: Workplace Ambassador I
Description:
**SUMMARY**

The role of the **Workplace Ambassador** will collaborate with various partners to ensure a high-quality seamless workplace experience is provided consistently for all employees. These partners include facilities and workplace experience teams, client employees, BGIS facilities and project teams, food service operators and fitness center operators. In this role, there is a unique opportunity to influence how employees work, and directly impact their workday. You will work with a team of professionals delivering workplace services including hospitality, reception, event space coordination, space occupancy and mail/package deliveries. In this role, you will be empowered to make decisions that are aligned with the organization’s workplace standards to ensure that the space continues to meet the needs of all employees. This role will support the key differentiator of the organization – it’s people, by enabling a culture of high-performance teams.

**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support**

* Face and go to person for the workplace strategy program in the office environment.
* Greet visitors, new hires and existing employees to explain the office space and how to work effectively in the space, how to utilize meeting rooms & access reservation system.
* Conduct periodic workstation reviews. Work with building property management and corporate Facilities Management, manage mail receipt and distribution, parking validations and guest access.
* Manage office supplies, relationship with offsite storage (Iron Mountain) security access cards (including reports and audits by security). Enforce clean desk policy. Rounds to ensure supplies in place – morning and evening.

**Technology Assistance**

* Program subject matter expert, provide problem solving solutions for administrative problems. Manage drop off for technologies requiring service. Escalation point of contact for office and technology issues.
* Provide basic how - to tech support and escalation process for all WTP toolkit technologies (wireless network, soft tokens, print release, AVAYA phone system, AV equipment, video conferencing, Smart Boards, etc.). Administer triage for meeting room technology – i.e. reset, reboot meeting room panels and lobby touch screens and/or manage escalations.
* Learn HR technology tools and provide HR and communications support (i.e. Yammer). Assist with minor event planning and meeting space set up. Provide local amenities maps.
* Manage the office sundry equipment for term use (mouse, power cords, power bars, spare laptops and desktops, monitor cables, network cables, head - sets, docking stations, keyboards, privacy filters, etc.). Manage locker / file cabinet inventory assignment and associated key control, name plates, etc.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

* University degree with 1-3 years’ of job-related experience.
* Service oriented, able to be customer-facing and can-do attitude.
* Able to exercise sound judgement, make decisions, provide direction.
* Comfortable dealing with issues and people. Strong communication skills.
* Strong computer skills, including MS suite of software.
* Self-starter, able to work independently as well as in a team.
* Pro-active, approachable, and solution-based.
* Ability to multi-task.
* Accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure.
Strong organization skills.  

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**

* None required

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $44,303 - $52,121 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role. |

Title: Concierge
Description:
**Come join our growing team!**

If you are looking for a rewarding role with opportunities for growth at a company that values integrity, innovation, and teamwork, look no further! Barkan Management Company is a leading property management firm serving over 200 residential communities across 8 states, with regional offices in Boston and Washington D.C.

  

Founded in 1964, we have over 50 years of experience in real estate, specializing in community association and multi-family management, encompassing market rate and affordable housing. Our team of over 800 talented professionals shares a commitment to delivering unparalleled service, maintaining the highest quality standards, and exceeding client expectations. Join us as we continue to redefine the standards of excellence in property management!

  

**Who we need:**

We are looking for a motivated, experienced, hands-on Overnight Concierge who will maintain a secure environment for the residents; ensuring that all residents and visitors are properly greeted and screened, supervise and direct the page, and provide residents with personal services in an efficient, responsive, and professional manner.

**What you’ll do:**

* Maintain complete knowledge of rules, regulations, and policies
* Welcome/greet all residents and guests to the property in a professional manner reflecting a willing attitude to accommodate.
* Announce all guests to units.
* Become knowledgeable with building service providers, i.e., limousines, taxis, cleaners, pet services, food delivery, and the like.
* Ensure that the front lobby is always well maintained; weather mats installed during inclement weather and removed immediately following; chipped paint addressed immediately, proper lighting, panel, and desk polished, and the like.
* Receive calls from residents for personal services and coordinate the same with the Page. Ensure that all requests are met in a timely manner.
* Supervise the activities of Page staff assigned to a daily shift, check for proper uniform and attendance. Make sure that all services are provided in a friendly courteous, professional manner.
* Ensure that the front desk is always covered.
* Accept deliveries in accordance with approved policy, mail, and dry cleaning, and maintain logs associated with each task.
* Receive calls from residents for maintenance or service and forward them to the appropriate person during routine business hours. For after-hour service requests, assess if the issue can wait until the next business day and login work order on Building Link. If appropriate notify maintenance on call to assist.
* Maintain strict adherence to key control policy, requiring that all visitors needing a key to be authorized to enter the unit. Log in all key requests.
* Ensure that all contractors entering the front lobby are properly badged observing the policy that tools are not allowed through the front door.
* Enforce the building rules and regulations as provided by the Board of Managers. Ensure that all contractors have security badges before entering the building.
* Carefully monitor all security and life safety systems and report problems to building security as well as the General Manager.
* Welcome new residents and assist with coordinating the delivery of newspapers, cable TV, peapod delivery laundry services, etc.
* Provide information about local activities and events throughout the city.
* Introduce new services and opportunities that may be of interest to owners and residents.
* Document all resident requests, complaints, or problems immediately and notify designated department/personnel for resolving the issue.
* Complete incident reports as needed.
* Perform duties as requested by Head Concierge and or Property Manager.
* Maintain a current listing of vendors including babysitting, housekeeping, pet care, florist, dry cleaning, restaurants, ticket agencies, theater, and the like.
* Ensure personal appearance is always immaculate; uniform clean crisp and shoes are polished.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Possess a wealth of knowledge about the area in which the property is located (i.e. Restaurants, transportation, events, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience in service and hospitality.
* Excellent communication skills
* Take pride in their appearance, their service role, and their commitment to services excellence.
* Have outstanding communication Skills – from professional writing to eloquence of speech and body language.
* Be able to demonstrate a proven history of reliability to a set work schedule.
* Bring an extremely engaging and attentive personality to a team of highly motivated hospitality professionals.

Job Location – The Concierge will be stationed at the front desk standing to greet residents and visitors as they arrive.

Organizational Relationship - Reports to Head Concierge

* Expertise en adoption et en gestion du changement : Expérience démontrée dans l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de gestion du changement et de programmes de formation pour des déploiements technologiques SaaS à grande échelle.

La connaissance des outils d'analyse pour centres de contact est un atout majeur.
* Mentalité commerciale : Capacité avérée à identifier et à soutenir l'optimisation avant-vente, l'expansion et les opportunités de vente incitative.
* Communication influente : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication, présentation et gestion des parties prenantes, avec un talent pour établir des relations de conseiller de confiance avec les clients.
* Compétences linguistiques : Le bilinguisme (français/anglais) est un atout, en particulier pour les postes basés au Québec.

Title: Consultant principal, stratégie et négociations
Description:
**Req Id:**
431929
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**À propos du poste**
À titre de Gestionnaire principal, négociations stratégiques, vous agirez comme conseiller(ère) stratégique auprès de l’équipe de direction d’IA tissé, en contribuant à l’avancement des priorités commerciales, opérationnelles et de croissance les plus importantes de l’entreprise. En combinant une approche structurée de résolution de problèmes, d’excellentes compétences en communication auprès des dirigeants et un leadership transversal, vous soutiendrez les décisions clés liées aux occasions clients et locataires, à la priorisation des sites, à la planification de la capacité, aux présentations destinées à la haute direction, aux relations gouvernementales et à la performance de l’entreprise.
  
  
Une responsabilité essentielle du rôle consistera à aider la direction à déterminer quels locataires et clients doivent être attribués à quels sites, en équilibrant la demande des clients, la disponibilité de l’alimentation électrique, les exigences en matière de connectivité, le niveau de préparation des sites, les considérations économiques, les échéanciers, la valeur stratégique et les risques d’exécution.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**

* Gérer et améliorer continuellement le pipeline des occasions clients et locataires d’IA tissé, en assurant le suivi de l’avancement commercial, des dépendances clés, des risques et des prochaines étapes.
* Élaborer des recommandations et des cadres décisionnels afin d’aider la direction à prioriser les clients, les locataires, les sites, les investissements et les occasions stratégiques.
* Agir à titre de partenaire de réflexion de confiance auprès des dirigeants en appliquant des méthodes structurées de résolution de problèmes et des analyses fondées sur les données pour relever des défis d’affaires complexes.
* Diriger des analyses stratégiques à fort impact, des analyses de rentabilité, des exercices de planification par scénarios et le soutien à la prise de décision exécutive concernant les priorités les plus critiques de l’entreprise.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des ventes, des partenariats, des finances, des affaires juridiques, de l’immobilier, du réseau, des opérations ainsi qu’avec les dirigeants afin de favoriser l’alignement et d’accélérer l’exécution.
* Identifier les goulots d’étranglement, les risques et les enjeux interfonctionnels, recommander de façon proactive des solutions et en assurer la résolution.
* Diriger l’élaboration de documents d’information pour le chef de la direction, de présentations au conseil d’administration, de présentations gouvernementales, de présentations destinées aux dirigeants et de communications aux parties prenantes.
* Traduire des informations complexes en recommandations concises et orientées vers la prise de décision, en mettant en évidence les principales occasions, les risques, les compromis et les actions à entreprendre.
* Soutenir les échanges avec les hauts dirigeants de Bell, les intervenants gouvernementaux, les clients, les partenaires, les investisseurs et les leaders de l’écosystème.
* Faire preuve d’une discipline exceptionnelle en gestion de projet dans le cadre d’initiatives rapides et ambiguës, en veillant à ce que les priorités demeurent sur la bonne voie et que les livrables critiques soient exécutés efficacement.
* Mettre en place une gouvernance claire, une responsabilisation accrue et des mécanismes de fonctionnement qui améliorent la visibilité, la prise de décision et l’exécution à l’échelle de l’organisation.
* Accroître la vitesse d’exécution en réduisant l’ambiguïté, en favorisant l’alignement et en veillant à ce que les priorités critiques progressent efficacement.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* De 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en conseil en gestion, en stratégie, en opérations, en infrastructures, en technologie, en télécommunications ou dans d’autres environnements à haute performance.
* Succès démontré dans le soutien à des cadres supérieurs au sein de contextes dynamiques, ambigus et à fort enjeu.
* Excellentes compétences en exécution et en gestion de projet, avec un historique démontré de réalisation d’initiatives complexes.
* Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes, notamment pour structurer l’ambiguïté, identifier les causes profondes et concevoir des solutions pragmatiques, évolutives et légères en processus.
* Expérience dans la direction de programmes interfonctionnels, la production de rapports destinés aux dirigeants, la gestion de pipelines critiques pour l’entreprise, de tableaux de bord et de priorités stratégiques.
* Capacité à synthétiser des situations complexes en constats, recommandations et actions clairs.
* Curiosité, grande capacité d’apprentissage et intérêt marqué pour les outils d’intelligence artificielle favorisant la productivité et la prise de décision.
* Le bilinguisme français-anglais est considéré comme un atout.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience de soutien auprès d’équipes de direction, de comités exécutifs, de conseils d’administration, d’instances gouvernementales ou de programmes interfonctionnels d’envergure.
* Expérience dans la gestion de pipelines liés aux clients, aux activités commerciales, aux ventes, aux partenariats, aux investissements, aux locataires ou aux occasions d’affaires.
* Une exposition aux domaines des infrastructures, de l’intelligence artificielle, des télécommunications, de l’énergie, de l’immobilier, des politiques publiques, des technologies d’entreprise, des réseaux, de la connectivité ou des partenariats commerciaux constitue un atout, sans être obligatoire.
* Expérience dans la préparation de présentations destinées aux dirigeants, de documents d’information pour le chef de la direction, de documents à l’intention des gouvernements, de tableaux de bord ou de mises à jour stratégiques.
* Intérêt démontré pour l’intelligence artificielle, les infrastructures numériques, la compétitivité nationale ou le développement d’entreprises à grande échelle.

Title: Principal (IT/Digital) | BCG Platinion
Description:
**Locations**
: Doha | Saudi Arabia
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
The Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.
  
  
**Practice Area**
BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
  
  
We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Principal IT/Digital in the Energy Practice, you will work closely with our client's leadership teams to understand their key challenges, define IT strategies, win buy-in for your recommendations and lead fellow BCG case team members to transform client potential into performance with high-impact assignments. You will deploy customized IT strategies, digital platforms and architecture in order to leverage the digital potential of our customers in order to deliver long lasting value. You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.
  
  
You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
  
  
Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Driving results in complex environments
* Solving business and technology problems
* Building strong client relationships
* Leading and developing teams
* Communicating complex topics clearly
* Collaborating across teams

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 8–12+ years in IT consulting or digital transformation
* Experience in Energy sector (e.g., Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals)
* Track record in IT transformation delivery
* Expertise in IT/ Digital architecture, cloud, data & AI topics
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management
* Excellent academic degree
* Excellent English communication skills, Arabic is a plus.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work in a collaborative environment with continuous development opportunities, growing toward Director-level roles while deepening expertise in Energy and IT/ digital transformation.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Title: Business Development Intern – B2B Technology Sales
Description:
**Role Overview**

The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential business opportunities, approaching companies, building relationships with decision-makers, and generating qualified leads for Bullseye Technology.

This is a hands-on, field-oriented sales role. The candidate will actively visit business districts, commercial offices, and business centres across Dubai to connect with potential clients.

The primary objective is to identify businesses that require:

* Corporate website design and development
* Custom software and web application development
* Business dashboards and digital platforms
* E-commerce solutions
* Branding and digital identity development
* Digital transformation and technology consulting

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Field Prospecting & Business Outreach**

* Visit commercial districts, business centres, and office buildings across Dubai.
* Identify and approach business owners, managing directors, CEOs, and department heads.
* Introduce Bullseye Technology and its services to potential clients.
* Establish relationships with business communities, consultants, and professional networks.
* Identify opportunities through face-to-face meetings and networking.

**2. Lead Generation & Market Research**

Identify and collect information on businesses that:

* Have outdated or poorly performing websites.
* Do not have a professional digital presence.
* Require website redesign or development.
* Are planning new digital products or platforms.
* Need custom software, dashboards, or business applications.
* Are expanding their operations and investing in technology.
* Require branding or digital transformation support.

Research potential clients and maintain an organized database of prospects, decision-makers, contact details, and business requirements.

Title: Systems Administrator
Description:
**Systems Administrator**
=========================

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Title** - Systems Administrator

**Department** - Client Support Services

**Type** - Full-time, permanent, salaried

**Reports to** - CTO

**Location** - Downtown Toronto office, with occasional client site work

As a Systems Administrator at Business Cloud, you are responsible for the security, availability, and recoverability of the systems our clients depend on across a portfolio of Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace environments. You remediate security findings, keep servers and network infrastructure patched and supported, verify that backups can be restored, and maintain consistent configuration across cloud tenants, identity, and endpoint management platforms.

Much of this work is proactive and does not start with a ticket. You find configuration drift, unresolved findings, and maintenance gaps through routine review, and you close them through direct work, automation, or coordination with other teams. Support handles frontline user issues; you own system-level problems and outages.

Your work falls into three areas:

* **Reactive**: Responding to security alerts and system-level escalations
* **Maintenance**: Carrying out recurring maintenance such as patching, backup verification, and monitoring review
* **Improvement**: Delivering small non-billable changes, cleanup, and automation that make environments easier to manage

Most work is performed remotely from our downtown Toronto office, with occasional on-site work for servers and network equipment. The role is client-facing. Some maintenance windows fall outside standard business hours.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Security and Incident Response**: Triage and remediate security findings and alerts from managed detection and response, Microsoft Defender, and endpoint security tools. Lead technical containment, eradication, and recovery during security incidents, preserving evidence and documenting findings and follow-up actions.
* **Backup and Business Continuity**: Administer backup and continuity platforms, verify coverage and job health, and resolve problems. Perform and document testing, confirm restore readiness before major changes, and escalate continuity risks that cannot be resolved technically.
* **Server Administration and Lifecycle**: Administer physical and virtual servers, including domain controllers, Hyper-V and VMware, directory synchronization, and remote and break-glass access. Coordinate patching and maintenance, validate service health, and plan upgrades.
* **Network, DNS, and Certificates**: Administer firewalls, switches, wireless, and VPN infrastructure across different environments, including firmware and alert response. Manage DNS zones, mail authentication records, and certificate renewals.
* **Cloud Platforms and Identity**: Administer client cloud environments, primarily Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, along with Azure and related services, keeping tenant configuration, identity, and access policies consistent and secure. Manage privileged and emergency access through a documented, controlled process.
* **Endpoint Management Platforms**: Administer endpoint management platforms such as Intune and our RMM to keep managed devices patched, compliant, and protected.
* **Health and Documentation**: Monitor for configuration drift and correct it. Conduct proactive environment reviews and cleanup efforts. Own small non-billable changes. Maintain current documentation of systems, configurations, and their relevant procedures.
* **Reporting and Automation**: Maintain and leverage reporting to automate repetitive checks and administrative tasks.
* Other duties as required.

**How do we define success for your role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Security findings and alerts are triaged promptly and tracked to resolution, with an owner and status for anything left open.
* Patching runs on a predictable schedule, and servers or devices that are behind or nearing end of support are known and documented, not discovered during an incident.
* Backups are monitored, failures are resolved quickly, and restore tests are performed and recorded on a regular schedule.
* Monitoring alerts have an owner and are acted on, and certificates and domains are renewed before they expire.
* Client environments move steadily toward our standards, with drift found through routine review and exceptions documented.
* Documentation is current enough that a colleague can pick up your work.
* Recurring manual checks are progressively replaced with reporting and automation.
* You contribute to an inclusive, engaging work environment and continue developing your expertise.

**Your Experience and Education**
---------------------------------

* 3+ years of systems administration experience, preferably supporting multiple clients or sites.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Hyper-V or VMware.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, or equivalent depth in Google Workspace.
* Experience with endpoint management through Intune or a remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform.
* Working knowledge of networking, including firewalls, VLANs, VPN, and wireless.
* Understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, patching, and responding to security alerts.
* Experience administering backup systems and troubleshooting backup failures.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell or a similar scripting language.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to clients.
* Availability for occasional after-hours maintenance.
* Post-secondary education in a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience at an MSP.
* Experience administering both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
* Experience with managed detection and response tools or incident response.
* Experience with cloud-managed network platforms such as Meraki or UniFi.
* Experience managing macOS and mobile devices.
* Experience performing restore tests or disaster recovery exercises.
* Experience building reporting or automation to replace manual checks.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Zendesk and Hudu, and with client-managed products such as password managers, VoIP, and phishing awareness tools.
* Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft 365 or Azure Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator, or networking certifications.
* A valid driver's licence and access to a vehicle.

**Why Business Cloud?**
-----------------------

Business Cloud is a rapidly growing managed technology service provider focused on delivering cloud-first business technology solutions to small and medium-sized organizations across Canada. As a proud partner of Google Cloud and Microsoft, we take full ownership of our clients' technology environments to ensure reliability, security, and efficiency.

Our core values reflect our commitment to growth and service:

* Growth and Development
* Ownership and Leadership
* Respect, Empathy, and Customer First
* Prevention and Proactivity

Our team's backgrounds and experiences vary, but effective communication, continual learning, and a passion for customer service are the common components of our success. If you believe you are the ideal candidate for this position, please apply and tell us why Business Cloud is the right fit for you.

**How can I stand out in my application?**
------------------------------------------

Please consider attaching a tailored cover letter. We view this as an opportunity to tell us why you are the right fit for the position and our organization.

Title: Telecom OSS Architect / Designer
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As a
**Telecom OSS Architect / Designer**
, you will be a senior technical authority within our Connectivity & Network Engineering practice, leading the architecture and design of complex OSS solutions for major telecoms clients in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery, working closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendor partners to define and implement best-in-class OSS ecosystems.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Leading end-to-end OSS architecture and design across Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management domains — defining solution blueprints, integration frameworks, and technical roadmaps aligned to client business objectives and industry best practices such as TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID).
* Driving the design and implementation of Network Inventory solutions, including physical, logical, and service inventory modelling, ensuring accurate and real-time representation of network assets across multi-vendor, multi-technology environments (2G/3G/4G/5G, Fixed, IP/MPLS).
* Architecting Performance and Fault Management solutions, overseeing the design of KPI frameworks, threshold management, alarm correlation, and root cause analysis capabilities — enabling proactive network operations and minimising service impact for telecoms operators.
* Engaging directly with senior client stakeholders to gather and translate complex business and operational requirements into detailed technical specifications, solution architectures, and HLD/LLD documentation, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Leading and governing OSS integration design, defining interfaces and APIs between OSS platforms and adjacent systems including BSS, NMS, EMS, and emerging cloud-native network management platforms — ensuring seamless data flows and operational continuity across the network operations ecosystem.
* Providing technical leadership and mentoring to a team of OSS engineers and designers, conducting design reviews, driving quality assurance of technical deliverables, and ensuring architectural consistency and compliance with agreed standards across project workstreams.
* Supporting pre-sales and solutioning activities, contributing to RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and solution demonstrations — bringing deep domain expertise to help shape and win new opportunities across the KSA and wider Middle East telecoms market.

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Telecom OSS Architect who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capability and a collaborative approach.
  
  
Technical Skills & Experience:
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on OSS architecture, design, and delivery — including proven expertise in at least two of the following domains: Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management systems, ideally in large-scale, multi-vendor operator environments.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of OSS platforms and tools, such as IBM Tivoli Netcool, Nokia NetAct, Ericsson ENM/ENIQ, Huawei iMAC/U2000, Comarch OSS, or similar — combined with strong understanding of OSS/BSS integration patterns, mediation layers, and data modelling techniques for telecoms network domains.
* Strong grounding in TM Forum standards and frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID/ODA) and familiarity with relevant industry standards including 3GPP, ETSI, IETF, and TMN — with the ability to apply these frameworks pragmatically in real-world solution design and architecture.
* Solid experience with integration technologies and APIs including REST/SOAP web services, TMF Open APIs, OSS/J, XML/JSON data formats, and middleware platforms — with the ability to architect robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions between OSS components and broader network management ecosystems.
* Proficiency in producing high-quality architecture and design artefacts, including Solution Architecture Documents, HLDs, LLDs, interface control documents, data flow diagrams, and operational runbooks — with experience presenting these at both technical and executive levels.

**What You'll Love About Working Here**
**Dedicated Innovation Labs**
– We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics such as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum. As a Telecom OSS Architect at Capgemini Engineering, you will be at the heart of this innovation — shaping the next generation of network operations for some of the world's leading operators.
  
  
**Career Acceleration Programs**
– From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise. With 12+ years of experience, you'll have access to programmes designed specifically to take senior engineers to the next level.
  
  
**Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services**
– Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleash their R&D potential to develop the smart products and services of tomorrow — and you will play a central role in that mission in the KSA market.
  
  
**Engineering Horizons**
– A global conference crafted exclusively for Capgemini Engineering colleagues, where excellence takes centre stage. Immerse yourself in opportunities to showcase your talents and connect with the brightest minds in engineering across the planet — building your professional network and visibility on a truly global stage.
  
  
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Title: Flight Dispatcher
Description:
**Accelerate your career with the most awarded Air Cargo Airline in Canada!**

Cargojet is Canada's leading provider of time-sensitive overnight air cargo services and carries over 1,300,000 pounds of cargo each business night. Cargojet operates its network across North America each business night, utilizing a fleet of all-cargo aircraft Cargojet has been awarded one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies as well as being awarded the Shipper’s Choice Award for the best Air Cargo Carrier in Canada for the past number of
  
years. Being part of Cargojet will allow you to become a part of a diverse and vibrant family at the leading edge of the air cargo industry both domestically and internationally. Cargojet team members are dedicated, hardworking, and have a strong sense of leadership and commitment.

##### **Primary Objective of the Position:**

Under the direction of the Manager, Flight Dispatch, Flight Dispatchers are responsible for operational pre-flight preparation and flight watch within a prescribed geographic area or for assigned flights in accordance with Canadian and foreign government rules & regulations, the Cargojet Flight Operations Manual, and company policies & procedures.

**Principle Duties and Responsibilities:**

* The production, review, authorization, issuance & revision of the Operational Flight Plan (OFP) for all flights inclusive of training and test flight operations, in keeping with safety, regulatory, customer service & corporate fiscal requirements,
* Authorizing the release of an aircraft to operate in accordance with the terms and conditions established by the OFP,
